event.bram_heart2.3.text: Hm. Now it listens. Strike. Hear that? No apology in it.
event.bram_heart2.3.why: the ring judged by his own aphorism: bad steel apologizes

event.bram_heart5.0.text: Wait. I owe you a sentence. It's been in the works since Tuesday.
event.bram_heart5.0.why: the compliment was drafted like his letters; a weekday makes it true

event.bram_heart5.1.text: You keep your tools like friends. Oil, rag, a dry shelf. That's the sentence.
event.bram_heart5.1.why: the drafted sentence lands as itself

event.bram_heart5.3.text: My teacher kept his tools like that. Hm. I should write him so.
event.bram_heart5.3.why: 'write' not 'tell': seeds the letters before heart 6

event.bram_heart5.2.text: Here. Two bars. Look after them. Iron keeps score.
event.bram_heart5.2.why: keeps the hand-over beat the new .1 dropped

dlg.story.whistler.bram.r2.text: ...Hm. You stayed. All of it. Most people leave before the sad part.
dlg.story.whistler.bram.r2.why: the tune has a sad part; sets up the teacher line after

dlg.bram.repair.0.text: Edmund's old hoe. He never let me near it. Split socket, blade's still good. Hold, strike, or watch?
dlg.bram.repair.0.why: a specific tool with a thread: Edmund's stubbornness, mended at last

event.bram_heart8.intro.text: Hm. Juno made something. All hers. Look quick, before I start measuring.
event.bram_heart8.intro.why: his real failure mode is critique, not ruin

event.bram_heart10.intro.text: Hm. Stand still. No questions. I practiced this part without you in it.
event.bram_heart10.intro.why: he rehearsed the gift; bigger than 'it's easier'

event.bram_heart10.thanks.text: {if choice:bram.juno.ask}You asked me once what I see. I still look. A friend. Rare metal, [player].{else}...Hm. Saved it nine winters. Didn't know who for. Now I do. [player].{/if}
event.bram_heart10.thanks.why: both branches now end on the first-ever use of the name

event.bram_friend.intro.text: Hm. Wednesday. Marcus is late. A roof somewhere, probably. Take his half.
event.bram_friend.intro.why: why Marcus is late, in Marcus's own habit

event.overheard_juno_bram_1.l4.text: Then peel the one off my apron. I'm Bram. Mostly.

event.overheard_juno_bram_4.l2.text: Good. Make it next door. I measured the wall. I'll visit. Daily.
event.overheard_juno_bram_4.l2.why: he already planned her forge; keeps the visit Juno's reply answers

adds.text: Hm. Come back when something breaks. Something always breaks.
adds.why: an invitation disguised as fatalism; the scene ends on a reason to return

threads.bram_heart2: Who is the teacher who saw cherry heat from the door, and where is he now?
threads.bram_heart5: Bram means to write his teacher that something he kept has lasted; will he send it?
threads.story_whistler_bram: The teacher's tune has a sad part and a wrong note Bram keeps on purpose.
threads.bram_heart4: Why would Edmund never let Bram near a hoe with a split socket?
threads.bram_heart6: Thirty letters in a drawer, unsent 'for now' - what would make him send one?
threads.bram_heart8: Will he tell Juno today, or near today?
threads.bram_heart10: He saved gold nine winters without knowing who for; what else is he saving?
threads.bram_friend: What roof kept Marcus from the Wednesday bench, and will the crumbs be counted?
threads.bram_birthday: No other mail: the letter Bram checks for on Fall 4 still has not come.
threads.overheard_juno_bram_1: Juno labels everything; the label on Bram's apron stays on.
threads.overheard_juno_bram_2: Bram's labels are verbs; what else has he quietly labeled?
threads.overheard_juno_bram_3: The bench keeps its one honest mistake, on Bram's orders.
threads.overheard_juno_bram_4: The wall next door is already measured for a forge that does not exist yet.
threads.overheard_wren_bram_1: Wren's fourth-word bet stands; a fish rides on it.
threads.overheard_wren_bram_2: Wren may get to fix the ending of a letter that will not be sent.
threads.overheard_wren_bram_3: Bram asked Wren not to go far; neither said why.
threads.overheard_tilda_bram_1: The slate between Bram and Tilda stays even, by mutual silence.
